_comment: Referenzmotive. Der Motivblock legt den Inhalt fest, nicht die Anordnung: Bildausschnitt, Farbe, Licht, Optik und Medium bleiben dem Stil überlassen (wie bei Designsprache). Eine Änderung am Motivblock macht alle Bilder dieses Typs ungültig. Version 1 legte die Komposition fest; die Stile wirkten dadurch wie Filter (siehe originals/_v1).

motifs.summary_de: Eine ältere Frau und ein junger Mann reparieren ein umgedrehtes Ruderboot am Kiesstrand.
motifs.summary_en: An older woman and a young man repair an upturned rowing boat on a pebble beach.
motifs.tests_de: Alter und Haut, Hände mit Werkzeug, Interaktion ohne Blick in die Kamera.
motifs.tests_en: Age and skin, hands holding tools, interaction without looking at the camera.
motifs.motif_en: Two people repair an upturned wooden rowing boat on a pebble beach. An older woman, about 70, sturdy build, short grey hair, weathered face, sleeves rolled up, kneels at the hull and presses a new plank into place with both hands. A young man of about 20, lanky, wearing a knitted cap and a jacket one size too big, crouches beside her and drives a nail into the plank with a small hammer, frowning in concentration. Between them on the stones: an open wooden toolbox, a coil of rope, a tin of nails. Behind them the sea, the end of a wooden jetty and two gulls. Both are absorbed in the work; neither looks at the viewer. Viewpoint and framing are the style's choice.

motifs.summary_de: Ein Fährmechaniker Ende fünfzig nach Schichtende, mit Narbe, schiefer Nase und angeschlagenem Emaillebecher.
motifs.summary_en: A ferry mechanic in his late fifties after a shift, with a scar, a crooked nose and a chipped enamel mug.
motifs.tests_de: Hautstruktur statt Weichzeichner, ob Makel und Asymmetrie überleben.
motifs.tests_en: Skin texture instead of airbrushing, whether flaws and asymmetry survive.
motifs.motif_en: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a fictional man in his late fifties, a ferry mechanic at the end of a shift. Broad, weathered face with deep forehead lines, a slightly crooked nose, ears that stick out a little, a short salt-and-pepper beard that grows unevenly along the jaw, and a small healed scar through his left eyebrow. He wears a knitted cap pushed back on his head and a work jacket with a frayed collar. He holds a chipped enamel mug in both hands at chest height; knuckles are visible and one thumb has a plaster on it. Three-quarter view, eyes looking just past the viewer, a calm, tired half-smile. The background is secondary and left to the style.

motifs.summary_de: Prozess-Infografik „Vom Korn zum Brot“ in sechs nummerierten Schritten.
motifs.summary_en: Process infographic “From Grain to Bread” in six numbered steps.
motifs.tests_de: Rechtschreibung, Hierarchie, ob der Stil die Informationsarchitektur verändert und nicht nur die Farben.
motifs.tests_en: Spelling, hierarchy, whether the style changes the information architecture rather than just the colours.
motifs.motif_en: A one-page process infographic titled 'From Grain to Bread'. Six numbered steps in fixed order, each with one simple pictorial element and a one-word label: 1 'Sow' (a hand scattering seeds over furrowed soil), 2 'Harvest' (wheat stalks and a sickle), 3 'Mill' (a millstone with flour pouring into a sack marked '500 g'), 4 'Knead' (two hands pressing dough on a table), 5 'Rise' (dough swollen in a bowl under a cloth), 6 'Bake' (a loaf in an oven opening marked '230 °C'). Arrows, a path or a numbered sequence connect the steps so the order is unambiguous; the layout (row, loop, zigzag, grid) is the style's choice. Title at the top. Layout, lettering and pictorial treatment follow the style's own conventions.
motifs.motif_de: A one-page process infographic titled 'Vom Korn zum Brot'. Six numbered steps in fixed order, each with one simple pictorial element and a one-word German label: 1 'Säen' (a hand scattering seeds over furrowed soil), 2 'Ernten' (wheat stalks and a sickle), 3 'Mahlen' (a millstone with flour pouring into a sack marked '500 g'), 4 'Kneten' (two hands pressing dough on a table), 5 'Gehen' (dough swollen in a bowl under a cloth), 6 'Backen' (a loaf in an oven opening marked '230 °C'). Arrows, a path or a numbered sequence connect the steps so the order is unambiguous; the layout (row, loop, zigzag, grid) is the style's choice. Title at the top. Layout, lettering and pictorial treatment follow the style's own conventions.

motifs.summary_de: Ein Flusstal mit Steinbrücke, kleinem Dorf, Terrassenfeldern und einem alten Baum mit Bank.
motifs.summary_en: A river valley with a stone bridge, a small village, terraced fields and an old tree with a bench.
motifs.tests_de: Tiefe, Horizont, wie ein Stil Natur abstrahiert; Jahreszeit und Licht sind Stilentscheidungen.
motifs.tests_en: Depth, horizon, how a style abstracts nature; season and light are the style's decision.
motifs.motif_en: A wide river valley seen from a slightly raised viewpoint. A river winds through the valley into the distance. In the middle ground a single-arch stone footbridge crosses it; next to the bridge stands a cluster of five or six small houses and one modest chapel, none of them a recognizable real building. Terraced fields climb the left slope, a dense patch of forest covers the right slope. In the foreground a single large, old tree leans slightly toward the river, with a wooden bench beneath it. Far behind, a jagged mountain ridge closes the valley. A small flock of birds crosses above the river; at most one tiny figure stands on the bridge. Season, weather and time of day are left to the style.

motifs.summary_de: Ein fiktives Kofferradio mit Lautsprechergitter, Senderskala und Teleskopantenne.
motifs.summary_en: A fictional portable radio with a speaker grille, tuning dial and telescopic antenna.
motifs.tests_de: Materialien, Kontaktschatten, gleichbleibende Zahl der Bedienelemente, Produktinszenierung je Epoche.
motifs.tests_en: Materials, contact shadow, a constant number of controls, how each era stages a product.
motifs.motif_en: Product image of a fictional compact portable radio, about the size of a hardcover book. Boxy body with softly rounded corners; a perforated speaker grille covers the left half of the front; on the right half sits one large round tuning dial above a horizontal frequency window that shows only tick marks; two small knobs below the window. A fold-down carry handle on top and a telescopic antenna, partly extended and slightly angled. The radio is shown alone and whole. Viewpoint, staging, materials, finish and backdrop are the style's choice.

motifs.summary_de: Plakat für das fiktive Festival „LORNHOLM – JAZZ & FILM“ mit Insel, Leuchtturm und Trompeter.
motifs.summary_en: Poster for the fictional festival “LORNHOLM – JAZZ & FILM” with an island, a lighthouse and a trumpeter.
motifs.tests_de: Schriftwahl je Epoche, Raster und Hierarchie, Texttreue, Zusammenspiel von Bild und Schrift.
motifs.tests_en: Typeface per era, grid and hierarchy, text accuracy, how image and type work together.
motifs.motif_en: A portrait-format event poster for a fictional summer festival. Headline 'LORNHOLM', subline 'JAZZ & FILM', date '18–20 JUL 2027'. The image combines three elements: a small island with a lighthouse, a single trumpet player, and the sun or the moon. How they are arranged, cropped, abstracted or merged is the style's choice. Headline, image and date form one deliberate composition with clear hierarchy; typeface, layout and ornament are the style's job.

motifs.summary_de: Konzeptbild zum Thema Reparieren: Winzige Menschen flicken eine riesige, gesprungene Teetasse.
motifs.summary_en: Concept image about repair: tiny people mend a giant cracked teacup.
motifs.tests_de: Bildidee, Weißraum, Ökonomie der Figuren, ob ein Stil Metaphern trägt.
motifs.tests_en: Clarity of the idea, negative space, economy of figures, whether a style can carry a metaphor.
motifs.motif_en: Conceptual editorial illustration for a magazine article about repairing things instead of replacing them. A giant porcelain teacup, cracked in several places, stands on open ground like a building. Three small human figures work on it: one on a wooden ladder stitches a crack closed with an oversized needle and thread; one sits on the rim lowering a bucket on a rope into the cup; one at the base carries a long tube of glue on her shoulder. A few large shards lie around the base. The scale contrast between tiny people and the huge cup carries the idea. Calm open space in the upper third, left empty for a headline that is set later.

motifs.summary_de: Eine Straßenecke mit Bäckerei, Wäscheleine, Hund neben der Bank und einer Frau mit Fahrrad.
motifs.summary_en: A street corner with a bakery, a washing line, a dog next to the bench and a woman with a bicycle.
motifs.tests_de: Perspektive, viele kleine Erzählelemente, Zurückhaltung bei Beschriftungen.
motifs.tests_en: Perspective, many small story elements, restraint with signage.
motifs.motif_en: A street corner in a fictional small town, seen from across the street. A narrow three-storey corner building with a bakery on the ground floor: an awning over the shop window, a hanging shop sign shaped like a pretzel without lettering, and a bench by the door with a dog sitting next to it. Upper floors: windows with flower boxes; in one open window a person shakes out a small rug. A clothesline with laundry runs from this building to the next. A cobbled lane slopes down to the right; a woman pushes a bicycle with a basket of bread up the slope. In the distance a generic bell tower, not a real landmark. The house number '12' beside the door.

motifs.summary_de: Brot, Tomatensuppe und Butter auf einem Holztisch, eine Hand reißt ein Stück Brot ab.
motifs.summary_en: Bread, tomato soup and butter on a wooden table, a hand tearing off a piece of bread.
motifs.tests_de: Texturen, Appetitlichkeit je Stil, eine Hand in mittlerer Größe, Zurückhaltung beim Styling.
motifs.tests_en: Textures, appetite appeal per style, a hand at mid scale, restraint in styling.
motifs.motif_en: A simple meal on a wooden table. A round loaf of crusty bread, one third of it cut into slices, lies on a cutting board with a bread knife beside it and crumbs scattered around. Next to it, a deep bowl of thick tomato soup with a swirl of cream and a spoon resting in it. A small dish of butter with a knife mark in it, a sprig of basil, a few cherry tomatoes still on the vine and a folded linen napkin complete the table. One hand enters from the upper right edge, tearing a piece off a bread slice. Small imperfections stay visible: a drip on the bowl rim, an uneven crust.

motifs.summary_de: Ein Graureiher im Moment des Fangs, Wasserringe, Schilf und eine Libelle.
motifs.summary_en: A grey heron at the moment of the catch, ripples, reeds and a dragonfly.
motifs.tests_de: Anatomie, eingefrorene oder gemalte Bewegung, Wasser.
motifs.tests_en: Anatomy, frozen versus painted motion, water.
motifs.motif_en: A grey heron stands in shallow water at a reedy riverbank at the moment of a catch: neck stretched forward and down, beak just closing on a small wriggling fish, a few droplets in the air. Both long legs are visible, the lower parts broken up by rings of ripples spreading from the strike. Reeds and a few broad floating leaves frame the left side; a dragonfly rests on the tip of one reed. The far bank is a band of vegetation in the background. The bird is seen in side view, its whole body visible from crest to feet.

motifs.summary_de: Ein Dachs als Dorfkurier mit Schirmmütze, Westentaschen, Schal und Paket klopft an eine Tür.
motifs.summary_en: A badger village courier with a peaked cap, pocketed vest, scarf and parcel knocks on a door.
motifs.tests_de: Formensprache, Grad der Vereinfachung, Ausdruck, gleichbleibendes Kostüm.
motifs.tests_en: Shape language, degree of simplification, expression, a consistent costume.
motifs.motif_en: An original mascot character: a stout, short-legged badger who works as a village courier. Rounded body, broad striped face, small round ears, short bushy tail. The badger wears a worn peaked courier cap, a short quilted vest with many pockets and a long knitted scarf, and carries a crossbody satchel stuffed with letters. Standing upright on a doorstep, it raises one paw to knock on a wooden door while the other paw holds a parcel tied with string, and it glances back over its shoulder toward the viewer with a cheerful, slightly out-of-breath expression. Full body visible.

motifs.summary_de: Illustrierte Karte der sichelförmigen Insel Lornholm mit Hafen, Windmühle, Leuchtturm und Fluss.
motifs.summary_en: Illustrated map of the crescent-shaped island of Lornholm with a harbour, windmill, lighthouse and river.
motifs.tests_de: Beschriftung, geografische Logik, kartografische Konventionen je Stil.
motifs.tests_en: Labelling, geographic logic, each style's cartographic conventions.
motifs.motif_en: An illustrated map of a fictional crescent-shaped island, seen from above. A harbour town sits in the inner bay with a pier and three small boats; a lighthouse stands on the northern tip; a hill with a windmill rises in the centre; a forest covers the south; a river runs from the hill into the bay; a winding road links town, windmill and lighthouse. In the open sea: wave marks and one sea creature. A compass rose and a scale bar in the corners. Labels: the title 'LORNHOLM', the place names 'Varn' (town), 'Eskel' (hill) and 'Moa' (lighthouse), 'N' on the compass, '1 km' on the scale bar.

motifs.summary_de: Neun Icons im 3×3-Raster: Haus, Brief, Lupe, Glocke, Kalender, Kamera, Pin, Zahnrad, Herz.
motifs.summary_en: Nine icons in a 3×3 grid: house, envelope, magnifier, bell, calendar, camera, pin, gear, heart.
motifs.tests_de: Konsistenz von Strichstärke, Radien und Füllung; ob der Stil ein System ist.
motifs.tests_en: Consistency of stroke, radius and fill; whether the style works as a system.
motifs.motif_en: A set of nine icons arranged in a 3 by 3 grid with equal spacing on one shared background. Row one: house, envelope, magnifying glass. Row two: bell, calendar page, camera. Row three: map pin, gear, heart. Each icon is centred in its cell, drawn at the same visual size and with the same level of detail and construction logic, so the nine read as one coherent family. No extra decorative icons.

motifs.summary_de: Fährpassagiere nach Lornholm, Juni bis September: 12, 30, 24, 6.
motifs.summary_en: Ferry passengers to Lornholm, June to September: 12, 30, 24, 6.
motifs.tests_de: Proportionale Richtigkeit (messbar), ob Ornament die Daten erdrückt.
motifs.tests_en: Proportional accuracy (measurable), whether ornament overwhelms the data.
motifs.motif_en: A single data chart showing ferry passengers to a fictional island over four summer months. Exactly four values in this order: 'JUN' 12, 'JUL' 30, 'AUG' 24, 'SEP' 6. The visual quantities must be proportional: July's mark is five times September's and two and a half times June's, August's is twice June's. Each value is shown as a number next to or on its mark. Title 'LORNHOLM 2026' at the top. The chart form may be bars, stacked pictograms where one pictogram equals 2, columns of objects or another honest encoding, but every quantity must stay readable and correct. No axis titles, no gridline numbers, no invented data points.

motifs.summary_de: Eine kleine, bewohnte Küche mit Kräutern am Fenster, Puzzle auf dem Tisch und Radio im Regal.
motifs.summary_en: A small lived-in kitchen with herbs on the sill, a jigsaw on the table and a radio on the shelf.
motifs.tests_en: Object counts, room perspective, materials, believable clutter.
motifs.motif_en: A small, lived-in kitchen in an older apartment. A window above a sink; on the sill three herb pots and a jar of wooden spoons. A wooden table with two mismatched chairs; on the table a half-finished jigsaw puzzle, a teapot and one cup. A kettle on a two-burner stove. Open shelves with stacked plates, glass jars of pasta and lentils, and a small radio. A wall calendar, a coat on a hook beside a second door. Everyday clutter: a folded newspaper on a chair, a bread bag on the counter, a tea towel over the oven handle. Nobody is present.

motifs.summary_de: Ein Quittenzweig mit Blüte, Knospe und Frucht, daneben der Längsschnitt und ein Samen.
motifs.summary_en: A quince branch with blossom, bud and fruit, beside it a lengthwise section and a seed.
motifs.tests_de: Blütenblätter, Blattadern, Logik des Schnitts, Umgang mit Leerraum.
motifs.tests_en: Petal count, leaf veins, cross-section logic, use of empty space.
motifs.motif_en: A botanical study of a single quince branch, arranged like a natural-history plate. The branch carries four leaves (one curled, one with an insect bite), one open five-petalled blossom, one closed bud and one ripe, slightly lumpy fruit. Set apart from the branch, with generous spacing: the same fruit cut in half lengthwise showing the core and seeds, one single seed and one detached petal. All elements sit on an empty ground; no pot, no vase, no table, no landscape.
